values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/pigeonbridge ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Pigeon River Bridge State Forest Campground, Otsego: 10 sites, $20, managed by Otsego Lake SP 989-732-5485, 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 10 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/pigeonbridge ('There are 10 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (10 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the Pigeon River in the Pigeon River Country State Forest, 10.5 miles east of Vanderbilt via Sturgeon Valley Road (a different campground from Pigeon River SFC, ~3.5 km away). Trout fishing; the Shingle Mill Pathway trailhead is across the road. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 10 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated). Boilerplate 'tent and small trailer' wording, silent on length. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; no ORV operation. Phone 989-732-5485 matches. Access via Sturgeon Valley Rd, no road warning. The amenity table calls it 'Pigeon River Bridge State Forest Campground'; the DNR page title is 'Pigeon Bridge State Forest Campground' (the entry's name). Note trimmed of field restatements.
